→ How many of this week's new signups paid?
→ Which feature is making duplicate model calls and burning money?
→ Which endpoint threw the most errors yesterday?

Send this prompt to Claude Code 👇

"Build me a Claude plugin just for my own use, so Claude can look up my product's data. Follow the official post and the docs it links to: https://t.co/R67dsqKMMc

1. First, find where this project's data lives: which database, which tables, and where error logs are stored. Only read the code. Don't connect to the database, and don't open .env.
2. Ask me what I most often want to look up, like daily signups and payments, how much model calls cost, and where errors happen. Then write a build list: the queries it needs, and what each one looks up and returns; a skill that explains what each table is for and how paid and active users are counted; and where the server will run. Use a read-only database account. The web and mobile apps need to reach it, so it has to be online, which means it needs a login that only my own account can use. Mask emails, phone numbers, keys, and anything like them.
3. Once I confirm the list, build it, deploy it, package it as a plugin, tell me how to upload and connect it in Customize > Plugins, and test it with one real question.

Ask all your questions and show me the list first, then explain how it works in words a 10-year-old could follow. Don't write anything until I confirm."

text:
纽约码农转行空调维修（𝐇𝐕𝐀𝐂）实战指南

𝟏. 先说现实

纽约市 HVAC 技术员平均时薪 $𝟑𝟎-𝟑𝟔（年薪约 $70K+，加班另算），新手 $24-30，有经验 $40-54。跟码农 $200K+ 总包比，HVAC 赚的是辛苦钱，不是"高薪"。

𝟐. 三条路线：在哪学

① CUNY 社区大学（City Tech）：2 年副学士（可 part-time 拉长），一年学费约 $𝟕𝐊，适合边上班边试水。布鲁克林 Environmental Control Technology 系，AAS 学位 HVAC&R，另有 pre-apprenticeship 项目。
https://t.co/HCt793QakX

② 私立技校（Apex，长岛市）：7 个月全日制/夜校，约 $𝟏𝟖.𝟒𝐊，适合快速全职转行。900 小时，含 EPA 608 备考。
https://t.co/3QYfCgrgA5

③ 工会学徒（UA Local 638）：长岛市 Steamfitters 培训中心，5 年带薪学徒，，名额有限先到先得。
https://t.co/P4AxnloS2Z

𝟑. 必须拿的证（按顺序）

① 𝐄𝐏𝐀 𝟔𝟎𝟖（联邦强制）：接触制冷剂必须有，考 Universal 级，自学 2-4 周，$25-120——
② 𝐍𝐀𝐓𝐄 认证：行业含金量最高，约 $25/门，找工作加分
③ 纽约本地：。给别人打工不需要；自己接住宅活（>$200）要办；做油炉/锅炉再考 DOB 专项（Oil Burner Installer / Refrigeration Operating Engineer）

𝟒. 时间表 + 码农的差异化优势

0-3 个月：考下 EPA 608；报名 City Tech/Apex 或投 Local 638；买基础工具（$500-1K）
3-12 个月：边上课边做 helper/installer，时薪 $20-28
1-3 年：独立 service tech，$30-40/时薪，考 NATE，选专项
4-5 年：商用/楼宇方向，$40-55/时薪，攒资质
5 年+：开公司或做专精方向

码农别浪费自己的优势：
• ：2.5 万平方英尺以上大楼 2030 年要减排 40%，电气化+热泵改造是政策逼出来的十年大活
• 楼宇自控（𝐁𝐀𝐒/𝐁𝐌𝐒）：曼哈顿高层全靠自动化，会编程学这个比老师傅快得多，时薪最高的细分之一
• ：自己写调度系统、做 Google 本地 SEO、跑广告——大多数 HVAC 小老板一窍不通
• ：纽约老楼烧 Con Ed 蒸汽，懂蒸汽+热水的技师稀缺，这正是工会 638 的地盘

𝟓. 事业规划 + 本周行动

三条线：
① 技术线：installer → service tech → 商用/BAS 专家 → 技术主管，年薪 $𝟔𝟓𝐊 → $𝟏𝟏𝟎𝐊+
② 老板线：办 HIC → 一人公司 → 3-5 人团队 → 轻商用/楼宇改造，做好年入 $𝟏𝟓𝟎𝐊-𝟑𝟎𝟎𝐊+
③ 混合线（最推荐）：白天做 BAS/热泵专家拿高时薪，副业攒客户，资质一到直接单干

本周就能做的三件事：
1️⃣ 查 City Tech 下学期课表和申请截止日
2️⃣ 给 Local 638 培训中心发邮件（recruit638@steamny.com）问学徒班什么时候招生，先排队
3️⃣ 买本 EPA 608 题库开刷，2 周内把 Universal 考下来看看你喜不喜欢这行

3-12 个月：边上课边做 helper/installer，时薪 $20-28

• ：纽约老楼烧 Con Ed 蒸汽，懂蒸汽+热水的技师稀缺，这正是工会 638 的地盘

③ 混合线（最推荐）：白天做 BAS/热泵专家拿高时薪，副业攒客户，资质一到直接单干

text:
这个开源 A 股复盘神器太省事了！

每天收盘翻涨停池、查龙虎榜、看板块资金，再手动整理复盘，最累的往往不是分析，是找数据。

开源项目 Vibe AStock，基于 OpenAI Codex Harness，把盯盘、复盘、个股研究和交易记录塞进了同一个本地网页。

最实用的几块：

1️⃣ 昨日梯队：固定前一天的涨停样本，谁晋级、谁断板、谁回落，一眼看清，缺行情的票也照样保留

2️⃣ 盘中异动：按行情快照整理急拉急跌、封板开板。是快照轮询不是逐笔成交，别指望一个不漏

3️⃣ AI复盘：情绪、资金、题材、龙虎榜、龙头跟踪五块，能点开“查看依据”核对

4️⃣ 多空辩论：结合行情、估值、财报、研报摆出正反观点，不强选赢家，也不给买卖点

5️⃣ 交易日志：持仓按日志算，买了什么、为什么买、后来怎么走，和研究记录放一起

6️⃣ 回测：输入历史规则，AI整理条件，你确认后再交给程序计算

最让我放心的是：行情和统计全由程序算，AI只负责解读材料，不是对着股票代码自由发挥。

支持 Codex、Claude 订阅，也能配 DeepSeek 等 API。Mac、Windows、Linux 都能跑，需要 Python 3.10+ 和 Node.js 22+。

🔗 https://t.co/B6I1yKhwAt

仅做开源工具分享，非投资建议，DYOR。

text:
Anthropic just published the official Opus 5.5 guide.

The first thing it tells you to do:

Delete "think carefully" from every prompt you own.

Opus 5.5 already thinks before every reply. It decides how much. That line adds latency and nothing else.

If your CLAUDE.md still says "take a deep breath" or "IMPORTANT: think hard" - those go too.

Here's the prompt that audits your entire setup and fixes it in one pass:

"Read this guide and review my project's CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, skills, and saved prompts. Find three kinds of problems: lines that push you to think more; rules that hand out tasks one step at a time; and rules that make you stop for confirmation when you don't need to. Show me the recommendations first. Don't modify anything yet."

Send that to Opus 5.5 with the full guide below ↓

12 tips. Every prompt copy-paste ready.

Bookmark this before your next session.

text:
Loved the recent article on evals from @HamelHusain
and @sh_reya in the  @lennysan newsletter. One question we get everytime with PMs is what evals to write for long horizon agents that do a broad swath of work (what H/S call error discovery, similar to product discovery).   

Below is a great framework for how you can organize these discoveries as a product team: 
1️⃣ Outcome - were the results great
2️⃣ Trajectory - was the process followed correct
3️⃣ Experience - did it feel right 
4️⃣ Governance - did it follow critical rules 

You start with your product pov, but the only way to hone focus is to look at traces (trace analysis). Here's an example of an annotated trace for a local shopping assistant called Corner and how often the trace reveals flaws before they become obvious to the customer. 

https://t.co/iYpCvt1etN

𝗖𝗼𝗱𝗲𝘅 𝘁𝗶𝗽: before you clean up ~/.codex, have Codex sort out what's safe to delete and what would take your chat history with it.

My disk was 96% full, so I checked: ~/.codex alone was 82 GB.
→ 54 GB of archived chats, 3,900 of them, going back to last November
→ the biggest single chat is 2 GB, and 21 are over 500 MB
→ the cache that's safe to delete comes to 𝘂𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿 𝟬.𝟮 𝗚𝗕

To free up space, move those old chats to an external drive and move them back when you need them. Full prompt below 👇
